# Yeshwanth Govindarajan

> ML Engineer and second-year MS in Computational Data Science student at Carnegie Mellon University.
> Works on multimodal AI, recommendation systems, and agentic AI.

## Featured

- [HeatMap](https://yeshwanthgovindarajan.github.io/projects/heatmap): agentic multimodal copilot that turns local competitors' Reels into shot-by-shot marketing video

## Projects

- [TIGER generative retrieval](https://yeshwanthgovindarajan.github.io/projects/generative-retrieval-tiger): generative retrieval on 1M real ad sequences
- [Diffusion feature distillation](https://yeshwanthgovindarajan.github.io/projects/naturalbench-diffusion-features): question-conditioned Stable Diffusion features for fine-grained image understanding on NaturalBench
- [Actor-critic planning in latent world models](https://yeshwanthgovindarajan.github.io/projects/latent-world-model-actor-critic): replacing CEM search with a learned planner
- [MoleculeAgent](https://yeshwanthgovindarajan.github.io/projects/molecule-agent): chat agent for protein design through MCP tools
- [All projects](https://yeshwanthgovindarajan.github.io/projects)
